why: This is the Kendachi plant's parking lot and garage in Rancho Coronado: a fenced yard with a raised walkway, yard gates, a building with a main door, a security outpost and a rooftop window. Vanilla only puts people here for the Breaking News gig, when Ted Fox waits in his car outside while V sneaks in and plants a tracker on the Kendachi transport. This proposal keeps the one quest prefab the venue needs and activates the factory's own eight-strong security detail in its only on-post phase (A), leaving Ted Fox, his car and the alerted phase (B) out. Doors and the transport's presence are left to the runtime door policy and a tour check.

open_questions: Check the eight Kendachi guards are on post and look calm, not clustered at the spawner or frozen. Every phase-A spot is an idle pose (coffee, cigarette, phone, rail lean, device fix, tablet, patrol), but the catalogue has no community-area node for this community, so its posture is unverified.

Walk into the lot unarmed and see how the guards react. A security_area_restricted controller sits at (-284.35, -1725.0, 7.44); if they open fire on sight, the venue is a restricted yard, not the calm factory lot this proposal assumes.
Check the front door and both yard gates open. Vanilla leaves them closed and unpowered; the runtime door policy should power them, and a quickhack or the security keycard should get you inside.
Check the Kendachi transport is parked in its spot and behaves like a normal vehicle (enter, drive away).
Look at the parking lot: is there more than the one parked Columbus? If it reads empty, vanilla's six fluff-car spawners need an activation this proposal cannot express.

communities.why: The Kendachi transport parked in its own marked spot in the yard (-298.89, -1744.6), so the lot reads as a factory with its vehicle present rather than a bare slab. Vanilla activates this entry from the same openworld phase that sets the venue up; no gig runs here, so it is just factory property.

proximity_wait.why: The factory building's front door, on the normal way in from the yard: a DoorControllerPS the openworld phase already drives (ForceClose/ForcePower/ForceUnpower), so it streams with the venue and is a device, not a workspot. The venue drives no terminal or gate closer to the guards' spots, and its device positions are unset in the catalogue, so the main entrance is the safest anchor.
